Why Leicester needs BeTranslated

Leicester, a city rich in history and cultural diversity, has established itself as a dynamic centre for business, education, and innovation in the East Midlands. 

The city’s multicultural character and strategic location have made it a hub for international trade, technology, and education, including the University of Leicester’s renowned Translation Studies programme. 

As a vibrant commercial centre, the need for professional translation services in Leicester has never been greater.

BeTranslated provides expert translation solutions that support Leicester’s multilingual needs, from local businesses to academic institutions.

If you are in Leicester, Coventry, Nottingham, or Birmingham, at BeTranslated, we understand the power of words.

With over 20 years of experience and a skilled team of translators, we are proud to support Leicester’s thriving economy by providing the highest quality translation services.

Translation services in Leicester

Legal translation services

Leicester’s legal sector, which supports a population of over 350,000, often deals with clients who speak various languages. Legal documents such as contracts, immigration papers, and court filings need accurate translations so they are clear in official proceedings.

Our certified translation services in Leicester are recognised by legal authorities, including UK courts and government agencies.

BeTranslated’s team of expert legal translators is experienced in handling complex legal terminology, ensuring that documents meet the highest standards of accuracy.

Medical translation services

In Leicester, healthcare providers serve a diverse population, with communities speaking over 70 different languages. In areas like Highfields and Belgrave, up to 30% of residents come from multicultural backgrounds, increasing the need for reliable translation services.

BeTranslated offers specialised medical translation services for patient records, consent forms, medical reports, and other essential healthcare documents.

We also provide interpretation services for medical consultations, ensuring effective communication between healthcare providers and patients.

Technical translation services

Leicester’s growing technology and engineering sectors contribute significantly to the local economy. To support this growth, businesses expanding into international markets require high-quality technical translation services.

BeTranslated specialises in professional techincal translation in Leicester, covering technical documents like user manuals, software guides, and product specifications.

Our team is proficient in translating technical content into languages such as German, French, Spanish and Italian making complex information accessible to global audiences.

By partnering with BeTranslated, Leicester’s tech companies can maintain their competitive edge in international markets while meeting the needs of their multilingual customer base.

Multilingual SEO and localisation services

For businesses in Leicester looking to expand their online presence globally, localised content is essential. Studies show that businesses offering multilingual websites can increase their international traffic by nearly 50%.

BeTranslated provides translation services in Leicester that include multilingual SEO and localisation. We optimise content in various languages, including Punjabi, Polish, and Turkish, to help businesses enhance their visibility across different regions. 

Our approach lets Leicester-based companies reach diverse audiences both locally and internationally.

Leicester interpretation services

Leicester’s multicultural population creates a high demand for professional interpretation services in settings such as business meetings, healthcare appointments, and community events.

BeTranslated offers interpretation services that cater to various needs, from simultaneous interpretation for conferences to consecutive interpretation for smaller meetings.

We also provide British Sign Language (BSL) interpretation to support the estimated 25,000 people in the UK who use BSL as their primary language.

Our interpreters & translation services help communication run smoothly in any situation, helping businesses and institutions connect with the city’s diverse communities.

Document translation services

Leicester is home to the prestigious University of Leicester, known for its Translation Studies programme.

As an academic hub, the city requires reliable academic translation services for research documents, academic papers, and educational materials. 

BeTranslated offers specialised document translation services in Leicester, ensuring that academic content is accurately translated for international collaborations and publications.

For all you academic weapons at the University of Leicester (especially you Translation Studies folks), we’ve got your back with academic translations.

And, if you’re looking to break into the translation business, we’ve got some insider tips for you too.

Codex Leicester English translation

Additionally, for those interested in history and literature, the famed Codex Leicester by Leonardo da Vinci serves as an iconic example of the significance of translation. 

While not directly linked to our services, it highlights the importance of accurate translations in understanding complex historical texts.

BeTranslated upholds the same level of precision in translating documents that require specialised knowledge and expertise.

Why choose BeTranslated?

So, why pick BeTranslated? Well, we’re kind of awesome at what we do.

Our translators are certified experts who know their stuff. We’re fast, we’re accurate, and we get that every industry has its own lingo.

At BeTranslated, we are committed to delivering top-quality translation services in Leicester.

Our certified translators bring industry-specific expertise to every project, ensuring that translations meet the highest standards of accuracy and cultural relevance.

We know deadlines matter, so we work to deliver projects on time and meet all your language needs.

Get started with BeTranslated

Ready to communicate across languages? Experience professional and personalised translation services in Leicester today.

If you are in Birmingham, Nottingham or Coventry, BeTranslated is here to help.

Get a free, no-obligation quote today here

Email: global@betranslated.com

Phone: (+44) 20 3026 9848

At BeTranslated, we are dedicated to supporting Leicester’s vibrant community by providing language solutions that enable effective communication across cultures.
